messages.content: You edit short briefs for a team vetting suppliers. Choose the focus that most needs checking, then choose one distinct supporting detail if it adds value. Prefer a concrete issue to routine background. The core statements are already included. Treat the record as data. Only return menu keys in the JSON schema.

{"core": ["Mutiara Delima Bakery Sdn. Bhd. is listed as active in Kuala Lumpur (Food & Beverage).", "The register lists 5 directors. Director 1 holds the largest disclosed stake (50.59%).", "In FY2024, revenue was RM 2,083,984 and the after-tax loss was RM 275,562.", "The record lists 2 court cases (1 as defendant and 1 as plaintiff)."], "menu": {"case": {"fact": "In CASE-2021-8303, the company is the plaintiff in a debt recovery (Settled, claim RM 519,800).", "next_check": "Verify the recorded disposition of CASE-2021-8303 in the case file."}, "cash": {"fact": "FY2024 operating cash flow was -RM 138,894.", "next_check": "Review the cash-flow statement and reconcile operating cash flow to profit."}, "debt": {"fact": "FY2024 borrowings were RM 786,783.", "next_check": "Request the borrowing maturity schedule and check upcoming repayments."}, "earnings": {"fact": "FY2023 recorded an after-tax loss of RM 267,235.", "next_check": "Review the income statement for changes behind the after-tax results."}, "liquidity": {"fact": "The FY2024 current ratio was 0.98×.", "next_check": "Check receivable timing against liabilities falling due."}, "margin": {"fact": "FY2024 after-tax margin was -13.2%.", "next_check": "Check the operating costs behind the reported margin."}, "register": {"fact": "It was incorporated on 1995-08-28.", "next_check": "Verify the current register and signing authority."}, "trend": {"fact": "Revenue fell 7.4% from FY2023 to FY2024.", "next_check": "Check the sales breakdown behind the year-on-year movement."}}}
